dt: Invitation-only; ~50 invited universities nominate internally (Yale internal deadline typically spring)
e: Early-career faculty at one of ~50 invited institutions, nominated by the university president; 20 fellows per year.
n: Packard Fellowships for Science and Engineering
unv: 2027 nomination timing and years-in-position window not posted on overview page

yale.t: Yale nominates through an internal InfoReady competition (2026 cycle's internal deadline was Jan 26, 2026). Yale Research Development holds a Packard / limited-submissions info session on Oct 6, 2026 (registration required); the 2027 internal date is not announced yet.
yale.unv: Jan 26, 2026 is confirmed from the Jan 21, 2026 newsletter. The next cycle's date is unconfirmed.
